purpose: Runtime adapter. Fashion direction must NOT be frozen into the Avatar Skill. This file is a SCHEMA; the instance is generated at task time from the current canonical catalogue so the skill stays identity-stable while the store's fashion direction evolves.

onStale: emit a wardrobeWarning naming the generation date

instanceShape.catalogueSource: path + SHA-256 of the build the context was derived from
instanceShape.activeCategories: list of category keys with live products
instanceShape.assortment: per-category list of {id, brand, name, category, subcategory, priceEUR, tags}
instanceShape.activeCampaigns: campaign keys present in the catalogue
instanceShape.silhouetteVocabulary: derived from product names/tags — the shapes actually stocked

rule: If no instance exists for this task, wardrobeSource=NONE and wardrobeConfidence=LOW. Never substitute avatar-source clothing.
